question: Choose the antonym of ‘meticulous’:
solution:
The correct answer is: **Negligent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"meticulous"** means showing great attention to detail; very careful and precise. (अत्यंत सावधानीपूर्वक)
 
 
• **Example: **She is meticulous in her preparation for the exams, ensuring every detail is perfect.
 
 
 
• **"Negligent"** refers to failing to take proper care in doing something; careless. (लापरवाह)
 
 
• **Example: **The employee was negligent in completing his tasks, which caused delays in the project.
 
 
 
• Hence, the opposite of **'meticulous' **is **'negligent'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Negligent**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Thorough **(संपूर्ण): Extremely attentive to accuracy and detail.
 
 
• **Example:** She conducted a thorough investigation into the matter.
 
 
 
• **Precise **(सटीक ): Marked by exactness and accuracy of expression or detail.
 
 
• **Example: ** The measurements provided were precise and accurate.
 
 
 
• **Careful** (सावधान): Making sure to avoid potential danger, harm, or mistakes.
 
 
• **Example:** Be careful while crossing the busy road.
